$comment: Lines for the free script engine (no AI). ENGLISH ONLY, always. Tone (Milan, 23-11-2026): sounds like someone who knows the game, one job per line, no shouting in capitals, silence allowed. Rule 1: say what is ABOUT to happen, never what is already on screen. 'anticipation' ends just before the peak; the engine picks a shorter one when the voice does not fit. {hearts} = number of hearts. Kid-friendly: no swearing, no mocking.
